subject.title: [Bug]: sessions_list API only returns main session — all other sessions missing from dashboard and API

question: Should a literal `session.store` path that matches `agents/<id>/sessions/sessions.json` be treated as a same-root multi-agent discovery root, or remain a single-store isolation boundary by default?
rationale: The issue is source-reproducible, but the available fix changes the interpretation of an existing config surface and needs maintainer acceptance before merge.

options.title: Accept same-root discovery after refresh
options.body: Resolve the linked PR conflict, keep the widened literal per-agent discovery semantics, and land with focused regression coverage and upgrade context.

options.title: Preserve literal isolation
options.body: Require a default-preserving implementation where literal paths stay single-store unless an explicit template or accepted migration opts into discovery.

options.title: Replace the branch
options.body: If the stale conflicting branch is too costly to repair, open a fresh narrow same-repo fix carrying the accepted semantics.

recommendation.title: Accept same-root discovery after refresh
recommendation.body: Resolve the linked PR conflict, keep the widened literal per-agent discovery semantics, and land with focused regression coverage and upgrade context.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest history signal is prior multi-agent routing and current session-store code ownership around this behavior.
